svg.title: Profile Weather View: live weather in your README
svg.desc: Live weather from Open-Meteo, patched into a marked table in your profile README and pushed as a signed, Verified commit three times a day. Example: Clear sky, 29°C, sunrise 05:41, sunset 18:02, humidity 74%.
